articles.headline: Airtel and Fundamental introduce Airtel Safe Report to track blocked cyber threats
articles.summary: Airtel and Fundamental introduce Airtel Safe Report to track blocked cyber threats Bharti Airtel has launched the 'Airtel Safe Report' feature within the Airtel App for its users. This feature provides detailed insights on intercepted cyber threats, scam alerts, and fraud warnings. It builds on Airtel's ongoing commitment to enhancing network-level security initiated in 2024. Airtel collaborated with Fundamental and Emotion Pictures to promote this initiative effectively. The company aims to actively fight against digital scams and protect consumer interests.

articles.headline: Media attorneys ask court for help in preventing White House ban until legal case is resolved
articles.summary: Media attorneys ask court for help in preventing White House ban until legal case is resolved An attorney representing three news organizations argued in a federal court that the Trump administration's ban is unconstitutional. This case highlights important First Amendment issues related to media access and viewpoint discrimination. U.S. District Judge Timothy Kelly has extended a temporary restraining order while considering a preliminary injunction. The news organizations assert that the president's actions violate free speech protections.

articles.section: Indian Festive Shoppers Balance Extensive Ai Led Research With Impulse Buys Google Ipsos Study
articles.headline: Indian festive shoppers balance extensive AI-led research with impulse buys: Google-Ipsos study
articles.summary: Indian festive shoppers balance extensive AI-led research with impulse buys: Google-Ipsos study Indian festive consumers engage in both detailed online research and spontaneous purchasing behavior during their shopping experiences. A study shows that 90 percent of shoppers compare prices and read reviews before making decisions. Interestingly, 70 percent of consumers also make immediate purchases influenced by visual content and urgency. AI tools are credited with enhancing the shopping experience among more than half of the shoppers.

articles.headline: EU pushes back at claims it bowed to US pressure over disinfo event
articles.summary: EU pushes back at claims it bowed to US pressure over disinfo event The European Union on Thursday rejected reports it withdrew its sponsorship of a disinformation conference in Lithuania because of US pressure, saying the decision was taken over the event's programme. Several media including British newspaper The Guardian reported that the EU and other backers including Canada and Lithuania dropped their sponsorship of the conference, organised by a non-profit group, following pressure from Washington.

articles.headline: Bestselling Hungarian newspaper shut down under Orban relaunches online
articles.summary: Bestselling Hungarian newspaper shut down under Orban relaunches online Nepszabadsag has been relaunched as an online news site and weekly magazine after a ten-year hiatus. Founded during Hungary's uprising against Soviet control in 1956, it was closed abruptly in 2016. The new Editor-in-Chief Akos Toth emphasizes returning to classic news-based journalism. Financed by Hungarian businessmen, Nepszabadsag plans to achieve sustainability through advertising and subscriptions.

articles.headline: Tata Tea Gold unveils Durga Pujo campaign backed by consumer study
articles.summary: Tata Tea Gold unveils Durga Pujo campaign backed by consumer study Tata Consumer Products has introduced its Durga Pujo campaign titled 'Ekshathei Gold' to celebrate togetherness. The campaign highlights the importance of shared moments over premium gifts, based on consumer research. A new television commercial portrays a mother and son at different life stages enjoying tea together. Specially designed tea packs featuring traditional themes are also part of the festive offerings.

articles.headline: Josy Paul elevated to Chairman and Group Chief Creative Officer of BBDO Group India
articles.summary: Josy Paul elevated to Chairman and Group Chief Creative Officer of BBDO Group India Josy Paul ascends to the role of chairman and group chief creative officer at BBDO Group India, where he will guide the creative direction of the group's three agencies, including BBDO India and Ulka. As a co-founder of BBDO India since 2008, Paul pioneered the agency’s 'Create acts, not ads' philosophy and oversaw impactful campaigns like Ariel’s 'Share The Load.

articles.headline: Bark Out Loud partners with Kalki Koechlin for 'Effortlessly Premium' campaign
articles.summary: Bark Out Loud partners with Kalki Koechlin for 'Effortlessly Premium' campaign Bark Out Loud has unveiled its exciting campaign 'Effortlessly Premium' fe aturing actress Kalki Koechlin. Highlighting the significance of simple yet high-quality nutrition for pets, the campaign juxtaposes Koechlin's intricate lifestyle with her dog Bruno's straightforward nutritional choices. Bark Out Loud's executives stressed the need for reliable products to promote pets' health, aiming to make premium nutrition an effortless pursuit for pet owners everywhere.

articles.headline: Washington Post names media veteran Alex Wallace COO
articles.summary: Washington Post names media veteran Alex Wallace COO The Washington Post welcomes Alex Wallace as its new chief operating officer, effective October 19. In her role, she'll work closely with CEO Jeff D'Onofrio to sharpen operational efficiency and streamline performance evaluations across teams. Wallace's previous leadership as executive vice president at Yahoo gave her oversight of major media platforms such as Yahoo News and TechCrunch.

articles.headline: Bank of Baroda launches 'bob Cyber Veeru' to boost digital fraud awareness
articles.summary: Bank of Baroda launches 'bob Cyber Veeru' to boost digital fraud awareness Bank of Baroda has unveiled 'bob Cyber Veeru,' a dynamic mascot dedicated to promoting digital banking safety. Launched for National Cybersecurity Awareness Month, this initiative educates customers on cyber threats, focusing on phishing and fraud through interactive videos and infographics. Furthermore, the bank provides training sessions for students and employees and values staff contributions in preventing fraud, amplifying its commitment to cybersecurity.

articles.headline: Skydance mashes proven properties of Paramount and Warner Bros. into an uncertain Hollywood hybrid
articles.summary: Skydance mashes proven properties of Paramount and Warner Bros. into an uncertain Hollywood hybrid Skydance, formed from Paramount's acquisition of Warner Bros. Discovery, aims to maintain continuity in its operations. The combined streaming services, HBO Max and Paramount+, are expected to unify in the future. Upcoming TV projects include a Harry Potter reboot and new seasons of popular series. The film slate is poised to focus on major franchises and high-quality theatrical releases.

articles.headline: WPP Creative appoints Tyler Turnbull as CEO
articles.summary: WPP Creative appoints Tyler Turnbull as CEO WPP has appointed Tyler Turnbull as the new chief executive officer of WPP Creative starting in early 2027. He will succeed Jon Cook following his tenure in this position. Turnbull previously served as the global chief executive officer at McCann and has extensive experience at FCB. In his new role, he will integrate WPP's creative agency brands with various capabilities.

articles.headline: TV news ad volumes decline 7% in Jan-Jul 2026: TAM adex
articles.summary: TV news ad volumes decline 7% in Jan-Jul 2026: TAM adex In the news genre, television advertising volumes faced a 7 percent drop between January and July 2026. articles.headline: Consumers replacing screen time with audio: NielsenIQ Study
articles.summary: Consumers replacing screen time with audio: NielsenIQ Study A recent study by Audible shows a rise in spoken-word audio consumption among listeners in 11 countries. Approximately 34 percent of respondents have engaged with more audio content than the previous year. Additionally, 51 percent intentionally replaced screen-time with audio experiences like audiobooks and podcasts. The report indicates that audio consumption complements traditional reading, with many listeners reading print or e-books after listening.

articles.headline: Indian firms seen posting faster profit growth despite global headwinds
articles.summary: Indian firms seen posting faster profit growth despite global headwinds Indian companies are projected to achieve profit growth during the September quarter despite various challenges affecting different sectors. Foreign investors are retreating from Indian stocks, impacting the benchmark Nifty 50 index's performance this year. Strong domestic demand and favorable conditions in certain sectors are expected to sustain earnings growth for many firms. Analysts believe that financials will be a significant driver of earnings, supported by healthy loan growth.

articles.headline: 4G mobiles make a comeback on costlier 5G smartphones
articles.summary: 4G mobiles make a comeback on costlier 5G smartphones India is experiencing a noticeable slowdown in the shift to 5G smartphones due to rising costs. As a result, the demand for 4G devices is increasing, especially in the INR 10,000-20,000 segment. More smartphone brands are now offering 4G models as consumers seek better specifications without the 5G price tag. Analysts indicate that this shift to 4G may persist as component costs remain high.

articles.headline: E-commerce firms turn to AI to solve for Bharat during festive sales
articles.summary: E-commerce firms turn to AI to solve for Bharat during festive sales From spotting trends before they become popular and predicting what consumers are likely to buy to personalising recommendations – AI is doing a bulk of the work behind the scenes.

articles.summary: Some oligarchs blocking entry of Starlink in India: Elon Musk Elon Musk has claimed that certain oligarchs are obstructing Starlink's entry into the Indian market. articles.headline: IMC 2026: Satcom security clearance pending with Home Ministry, says Pemmasani
articles.summary: IMC 2026: Satcom security clearance pending with Home Ministry, says Pemmasani Speaking on the sidelines of India Mobile Congress 2026, the minister said that the Department of Telecom has issued licences to all satcom companies as well as provisional spectrum.

articles.headline: GST relief for gaming companies raises hopes across the sector
articles.summary: Tax authorities have revised GST demands significantly for several gaming companies after a critical Supreme Court ruling. Pacific Gaming has seen its GST demand drop from INR 721 crore to INR 100.8 crore, indicating a substantial reduction. Delta Corp's combined GST demand has decreased from INR 16,000 crore to approximately INR 117 crore, offering some relief. While some firms await further orders, the industry is seeking personal liability waivers.

articles.headline: Homegrown tech brands projected to cross INR 2 lakh crore revenue by FY36: Report
articles.summary: Homegrown tech brands projected to cross INR 2 lakh crore revenue by FY36: Report At an expected growth rate of about 13 per cent a year, homegrown consumer technology brands could earn about Rs 1.11 lakh crore by FY2031 and Rs 2.04 lakh crore by FY2036, according to the inaugural Viksit Tech 47 Report released on Thursday.

articles.headline: Drug panel rejects child images on cough syrup labels, proposes age warning for use below 4 years
articles.summary: Drug panel rejects child images on cough syrup labels, proposes age warning for use below 4 years Cough syrup bottles will soon include a prominent red warning stating their use is not recommended for children under four. An expert committee rejected child-oriented imagery on labels, which could imply suitability for young children. This decision follows ongoing concerns about the safety of cough syrups in pediatric care. The proposed change aims to prevent confusion regarding age restrictions for these medications.

articles.headline: For your eyes only - Season two: How brands are missing a huge opportunity in lens care
articles.summary: For your eyes only - Season two: How brands are missing a huge opportunity in lens care The demand for prescription glasses is rising rapidly, with nearly 57% of the global population needing them. Kobayashi Healthcare has introduced cleaning wet wipes called Quikwipe, which are easily available in stores. Additionally, innovative lens-cleaning devices are being developed to enhance user experience. Exclusive

articles.summary: Karthik Gurumurthy aims to ensure TenxYou's long-term success through a focus on product quality and consumer feedback. The brand is operating in the competitive INR 2,000-5,000 footwear market while trying to distinguish itself from established international competitors. Gurumurthy plans for significant offline expansion, intending to open numerous physical stores in the coming months. The approach includes engaging strategies for customer interaction and leveraging data for product development.

articles.headline: Festive rush: Airlines hike fuel surcharge as ATF prices soar
articles.summary: Festive rush: Airlines hike fuel surcharge as ATF prices soar Airlines like Air India and Akasa Air have announced increased fuel surcharges for both domestic and international flights. The rise in aviation turbine fuel prices has significantly impacted operational costs for carriers. Domestic surcharges will be effective on new bookings from October 9, as the festive season approaches. International surcharges vary depending on destination, reflecting additional costs incurred by airlines.

articles.headline: AI cloning opens new monetisation route for celebrities, creators
articles.summary: Artificial intelligence is creating a new revenue stream for celebrities and digital creators by allowing them to license AI-generated versions of their faces and voices. The opportunity spans advertising, branded content and digital media, but also raises questions around consent, unauthorised replication and ownership of digital identities.

articles.headline: Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc ‘hijack’ Ferrari social media, team responds
articles.summary: Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc ‘hijack’ Ferrari social media, team responds Ferrari’s social media accounts had an unusual day in Singapore after drivers Lewis Hamilton and Charles Leclerc took control of them for a few hours. The two drivers shared photos and videos, played with filters, changed the team’s profile picture and interacted with fans.

articles.headline: Cheaper Scotch: More buyers say cheers!
articles.summary: Cheaper Scotch: More buyers say cheers! The latest pricing shifts have resulted in lower Scotch whisky prices, igniting competition against Indian whisky brands. Since September, Diageo and others have begun implementing price cuts, aided by a favorable trade agreement between India and the UK that significantly slashed import duties. In turn, Indian whisky producers are honing in on quality and craftsmanship, reflecting a noteworthy evolution in the Indian whisky sector.

articles.headline: Succession battle breaks out at TVS as camps disagree over business division, family MoU
articles.summary: Succession battle breaks out at TVS as camps disagree over business division, family MoU Deep disagreements over inheritance have emerged between Venu and Mallika Srinivasan's children, leading to potential legal action. articles.headline: Apple may launch its first touch-screen MacBook on October 27: Report
articles.summary: Apple may launch its first touch-screen MacBook on October 27: Report Apple is anticipated to unveil its first touch screen MacBook on October 27 this year. The event will also showcase new versions of the 14-inch MacBook Pro and iMac featuring M6 chips. Additionally, a new iPad mini is expected to be announced along with these products. This launch follows their smart home event on October 13, where a new smart home hub will be revealed.

articles.headline: FMCG Q2: Margins under pressure
articles.summary: FMCG Q2: Margins under pressure Fast-moving consumer goods companies are experiencing increased commodity costs, alongside the impact of weak monsoons on consumption. Despite these challenges, companies are projecting revenue and volume growth for the quarter. However, analysts expect profitability pressures to continue, which may limit earnings surprises. Selective price hikes have negated some benefits from GST cuts in the domestic market. Overall, the outlook remains cautious as companies monitor inflationary conditions closely.

articles.headline: ‘India moved from consumer to creator’: PM Modi urges GSMA, telecom firms to build mechanism against cross-border fraud
articles.summary: ‘India moved from consumer to creator’: PM Modi urges GSMA, telecom firms to build mechanism against cross-border fraud Prime Minister Narendra Modi called for global collaboration to address rising cross-border cybercrime during the 10th India Mobile Congress. He emphasized the importance of trust in digital services for their wider adoption and use. Modi proposed establishing a mechanism through GSMA and telecom operators to combat digital fraud effectively. India expressed readiness to share its experiences in tackling cyber threats with other nations.

articles.headline: More layoff pain: Nike, airBaltic and Microsoft's Hellblade studio announce major job cuts
articles.summary: More layoff pain: Nike, airBaltic and Microsoft's Hellblade studio announce major job cuts Nike is planning to implement further job cuts as part of its restructuring programme, which began in March. Meanwhile, developers at Hellblade studio Ninja Theory have reported layoffs, affecting several members of the team. European airline airBaltic is also considering cutting between 500 and 700 jobs, with decisions expected to be finalized soon. These changes are causing uncertainty among employees and may impact ongoing projects significantly.

articles.headline: The rise of the ‘Daycation’: How travel brands are marketing shorter, more frequent getaways
articles.summary: The rise of the ‘Daycation’: How travel brands are marketing shorter, more frequent getaways The travel landscape in India is evolving towards shorter, more spontaneous trips in addition to annual vacations. Many individuals are now opting for daycations, which are brief escapes from everyday life. Travel brands are adapting their strategies to market occasions that create a reason for travel. Short trips are making travel experiences feel more significant and meaningful for many travelers.

articles.headline: Amazon settlement payments 2026: Who qualifies for up to USD 200 and when will eligible Prime customers get paid?
articles.summary: Amazon settlement payments 2026: Who qualifies for up to USD 200 and when will eligible Prime customers get paid? Amazon is preparing to send another round of payments to consumers affected by its Prime enrollment and cancellation practices. The payments are part of a USD 2.5 billion settlement reached with the Federal Trade Commission in 2025. The FTC said Amazon has already paid more than USD 845 million to consumers as of September 2026. The latest changes will expand the group of customers eligible for payments and raise the maximum amount some consumers can receive.

articles.headline: BMC entertainment tax proposal likely to marginally increase ticket prices by Rs 5-10
articles.summary: Mumbai movie tickets could become Rs 5-10 more expensive if the BMC raises its per-show entertainment tax from Rs 60 to Rs 400. articles.headline: Paramount streaming shake-up: HBO’s Casey Bloys set to take over as Cindy Holland exits ahead of Warner Bros. mega merger
articles.summary: Cindy Holland has officially announced her exit from Paramount's streaming division, coinciding with a significant merger announcement. Paramount is set to acquire Warner Bros. Discovery for approximately USD 110 billion. The resulting combined streaming operations will be under the leadership of Casey Bloys from HBO. As the merger unfolds, details regarding the unified functionality of Paramount+ and HBO Max are still in the works.

articles.headline: Non-hotel brands hold 61% of India’s branded residences market: GBR
articles.summary: Non-hotel brands hold 61% of India’s branded residences market: GBR Non-hotel brands account for 61 per cent of India’s branded residences market, making the country an outlier in Asia-Pacific, according to Global Branded Residences. India has 61 branded residential schemes, with 37 in the pipeline. Hotel brands are gaining ground, accounting for 46 per cent of pipeline projects compared with 29 per cent of completed developments.

articles.headline: David Beckham’s £84M business empire makes almost £50M profit as his name becomes the product
articles.summary: David Beckham’s £84M business empire makes almost £50M profit as his name becomes the product David Beckham’s business empire generated £84 million in revenue in 2025, with pre-tax profit reaching nearly £50 million. articles.headline: Tata Sons' Chandrasekaran lists 3 priorities to keep India’s growth engine humming
articles.summary: Tata Sons' Chandrasekaran lists 3 priorities to keep India’s growth engine humming Tata Sons Chairman N Chandrasekaran said India’s economy remains robust and resilient despite global uncertainty, with strong domestic demand, services exports and government policy supporting growth.

articles.summary: Marketing Campaign ROI: How Much Should Brands Spend to Win Customers in South India? This campaign continues Sanon's partnership with Zouk, connecting the brand's Indian identity with younger audiences.

articles.headline: Amazon sees 35-40 pc festive demand spike, adds 50 pc capacity with Rs 2,800 crore investment

articles.headline: MarTech+ Summit 2026: Swiggy cuts campaign load by half in agentic marketing test, sees 5% higher reactivation
articles.summary: MarTech+ Summit 2026: Swiggy cuts campaign load by half in agentic marketing test, sees 5% higher reactivation Swiggy is innovating its marketing strategies by harnessing the power of AI to reconnect with inactive users. They are utilizing autonomous systems that tailor campaign execution to individual customer behaviors, allowing for more relevant communication and optimized campaign frequency. The introduction of Merlin AI facilitates quicker campaign development while ensuring high-quality standards. Ultimately, these advancements are designed to enhance user satisfaction and drive business growth.

articles.headline: MarTech+ Summit 2026: Brands rethink customer value as repeat, relevance and community take centre stage
articles.summary: MarTech+ Summit 2026: Brands rethink customer value as repeat, relevance and community take centre stage Brands are exploring customer engagement strategies beyond discounts, focusing on consumer motivations and purchase intent. Panelists at the ET MarTech+ Summit examined how understanding customer behavior drives brand loyalty and long-term value. They emphasized the significance of customer journeys and personalizing engagements based on purchase patterns. Innovative approaches include early interventions and utilizing customer feedback in product development.

articles.headline: Brand brews on International Coffee Day
articles.summary: Brand brews on International Coffee Day International Coffee Day saw brands take a creative spin with nostalgia shaping their campaigns. Café Coffee Day delved into personal coffee stories, creating connections with their audience, while brands like Bandhan Bank and Nescafé India presented clever metaphors and engaging visuals that brought their products to life. Social media lit up with inventive coffee-themed promotions, highlighting the beloved drink's significance in daily routines.

articles.headline: Unveiling ETBrandEquity Townhall: Inside the Closed-Door Room To Decide the Fate of Attention
articles.summary: As the role of marketing expands beyond brand building, the Townhall will examine how CMOs can influence business growth, earn boardroom trust and lead organisations. The discussions will also explore the creative and technological shifts reshaping how brands connect with consumers.

articles.headline: Groww appoints Santosh Hegde as Head of Growth
articles.summary: Groww appoints Santosh Hegde as Head of Growth Santosh Hegde has recently taken on the role of Head of Growth at Groww, succeeding his position at Atlys. His career spans over 15 years, including leadership roles at various renowned companies like Licious and Disney+ Hotstar. At Atlys, he was responsible for global marketing and revenue growth from August 2024 to May 2026. Hegde's experience also includes significant contributions to brand management during his seven years at Marico.

articles.headline: Ghadi Detergent signs Madhuri Dixit as brand ambassador for ‘Vishwas Ki Pariksha’
articles.summary: Ghadi Detergent signs Madhuri Dixit as brand ambassador for ‘Vishwas Ki Pariksha’ RSPL Group has introduced a new brand campaign named 'Vishwas Ki Pariksha' for Ghadi Detergent. The campaign features actress Madhuri Dixit and highlights a new formulation designed for better laundry care. This upgraded product focuses on improved lather generation, deeper fabric penetration, and faster dissolution in water. The launch is accompanied by new packaging to enhance consumer experience across retail outlets.

articles.headline: India’s mall market heads towards larger formats, greater consolidation
articles.summary: India’s mall market heads towards larger formats, greater consolidation India's shopping mall sector is on the brink of remarkable growth, planning to introduce 51.1 million sq ft of new retail space. Key urban hubs like Delhi NCR and Hyderabad are expected to be at the forefront, contributing significantly to this expansion. By 2031, the total mall space is anticipated to reach 143.2 million sq ft, highlighting a pivot towards immersive consumer experiences to cater to evolving shopping preferences.

articles.headline: Schneider Electric spotlights Unica Pure+ switches in new festive campaign
articles.summary: Schneider Electric spotlights Unica Pure+ switches in new festive campaign Schneider Electric has announced the launch of its campaign, 'Pure Design, Pure Delight', for Unica Pure+ switches. This campaign targets contemporary homes, luxury residences, boutique hotels, and premium workspaces in India. The advertisements showcase a family interacting with the flat switch design while highlighting its aesthetic appeal and functionality. The product is compatible with the Wiser Home Automation system and available in four elegant finishes.

articles.headline: Freyr Energy signs Rohit Sharma as brand ambassador
articles.summary: Freyr Energy signs Rohit Sharma as brand ambassador Freyr Energy has announced that cricketer Rohit Sharma will become its first brand ambassador for solar initiatives. The partnership introduces a campaign promoting rooftop solar as a long-term commitment. It is aimed at encouraging residential solar adoption in line with government schemes. Saurabh Marda emphasized the importance of reliability in solar partnerships for consumers. Sharma stated the significance of trustworthy partnerships for families opting for rooftop solar.

articles.headline: PhonePe gets India’s fastest speaker to name 70 crore users as it completes 10 years
articles.summary: PhonePe gets India’s fastest speaker to name 70 crore users as it completes 10 years PhonePe has launched a new campaign to commemorate its 10th anniversary and surpassing 70 crore users. The campaign features Shahu Supreme, a renowned fast speaker, attempting to name every user. This creative effort highlights the everyday interactions that have contributed to the platform's growth. Amit Doshi expressed gratitude towards customers for their support over the years.

articles.headline: Zee sharpens growth strategy with focus on digital, sports and regional content
articles.summary: Zee Entertainment Enterprises Ltd has articulated its vision for future expansion in the media sector. The company plans to invest in language-specific content and enhance digital profitability through a seven-language strategy. Additionally, it aims to diversify into short-form formats and enhance its portfolio in movies and music. The CEO expressed the importance of innovation and capability development for competitive advantage.

articles.headline: Friends tackles adult diaper stigma among middle-aged women with new campaign
articles.summary: Friends tackles adult diaper stigma among middle-aged women with new campaign Friends, an adult diaper brand by Nobel Hygiene Limited, has launched a TV campaign for middle-aged women. The campaign addresses the stigma associated with urinary incontinence and promotes product adoption. It aims to reassure women by highlighting support from friends and the importance of discretion. The film narrates a travel scenario where a woman's apprehensions about using adult diapers are alleviated.

articles.headline: Interio by Godrej brings a slice of Indian household life to new campaign
articles.summary: Interio by Godrej brings a slice of Indian household life to new campaign Interio by Godrej has unveiled a campaign showcasing its steel kitchens, highlighting their blend of contemporary design and durability for busy Indian households. The film features a couple, their neighbors, and household help, emphasizing the kitchen's role as a central hub in daily life. The campaign will be promoted across various digital platforms.

articles.headline: MTR Foods turns sweets into a language with new festive campaign
articles.summary: MTR Foods turns sweets into a language with new festive campaign MTR Foods launched the 'India’s Sweetest Language' festive campaign, featuring an illustrated book and a digital film. This initiative highlights the use of sweets to express emotions during celebrations and family gatherings, showcasing familiar expressions. The campaign also includes collaborations and activations to emphasize the cultural significance of sweets in Indian festivities.

articles.headline: Maid Vs Media: Who really sells the festive spirit?
articles.summary: Maid Vs Media: Who really sells the festive spirit? The humble maid as a competitor to the might of media? Well, that is the irony of the festive season. And the opportunity too.

articles.headline: Maharashtra FDA tightens infant food norms, says no free samples, gifts or influencer promotion
articles.summary: Maharashtra FDA tightens infant food norms, says no free samples, gifts or influencer promotion The food safety watchdog stipulated fines up to INR 10 lakh for violations like misleading advertisements and substandard food, and insisted advertising of formula milk and infant foods, free samples, gifts, cashback, influencer promotion and social-media promotion are prohibited.

articles.headline: I paid to suffer. LVMH's fund decided suffering is worth €600 million. One of us is irrational.
articles.summary: Nine days before I ran HYROX Mumbai, a consortium led by L Catterton, the private equity firm co-owned by LVMH and the Arnault family, bought a majority stake in HYROX at a reported €600 million valuation. The price they paid wasn't disclosed. Mine was.

articles.headline: OnePlus India brings generations together in new Diwali campaign
articles.summary: OnePlus India brings generations together in new Diwali campaign OnePlus India launched its Diwali campaign, #MakeItSpecial, aimed at bridging generational gaps through shared celebration experiences. Featuring notable personalities, the campaign highlights a blend of traditional and modern festivities, showcasing interactions between grandparents and their grandchildren. The initiative also collaborates with Marzi, a platform for individuals aged 50 and above.

articles.headline: From customer intelligence to autonomous growth intelligence, three A’s
articles.summary: The evolution of Customer Data Platforms (CDPs) is shifting from merely organizing customer data to utilizing AI for growth intelligence. This new focus centers on understanding consumer needs, identifying growth opportunities, and measuring the impact of business interventions, ultimately transforming CDPs into comprehensive Growth Decision Platforms that drive sustainable growth.

articles.headline: The New Currency of Trust, Introducing 4I’s
articles.summary: The New Currency of Trust, Introducing 4I’s Why Integrity, Identification, Inclusion and Intent may define the next generation of brands. Exclusive

articles.headline: Rasha Thadani and Rohit Saraf star in Nykaa Cosmetics’ Lovestruck campaign
articles.summary: Rasha Thadani and Rohit Saraf star in Nykaa Cosmetics’ Lovestruck campaign Thadani, the face of Nykaa Cosmetics, stars alongside Saraf in a story that develops across three films.

articles.headline: AI deflation, weak demand to keep large IT growth muted in Q2FY27; mid-tier to outperform: Kotak
articles.summary: AI deflation, weak demand to keep large IT growth muted in Q2FY27; mid-tier to outperform: Kotak India's large IT companies are expected to report another muted quarter in Q2FY27 as AI-led deflation and weak demand weigh on growth, while mid-tier firms are likely to outperform on market-share gains and stronger execution, according to a report by Kotak Institutional Equities.

articles.headline: Electric 2-wheeler sales cross 15 lakh in just 9 months as adoption rockets
articles.summary: Electric 2-wheeler sales cross 15 lakh in just 9 months as adoption rockets The growth for the sector also comes in the backdrop of two-wheeler brands expanding their customer base and targeting mass-market category. Earlier focused on performance-oriented electric scooters at a premium price, many manufacturers are now tapping the family scooter segment.

articles.headline: Haier, Godrej, Blue Star failed to detect fake e-waste recycling claims, India notice shows
articles.summary: Haier, Godrej, Blue Star failed to detect fake e-waste recycling claims, India notice shows Indian tax authorities have identified major appliance companies incorrectly claiming tax credits for non-existent e-waste processing services. The companies relied on documents from a recycler accused of fabrication and lacked verification of actual work done. Haier, Godrej & Boyce, and Blue Star face penalties for these false claims, totaling about $714,000. Investigators have found manipulated photographs used to support compliance with recycling regulations.

articles.headline: Telcos, consumer groups clash over TRAI’s 5G slicing, service quality rules
articles.summary: Telcos also emphasised that the wide-ranging overhauls proposed by the telecom regulatory authority of India (TRAI) will require significant changes including IT architectures, data pipelines, geospatial platforms, customer service systems, and cross-functional procedures, making the proposed effective start date unachievable.

articles.headline: HDFC Bank names ICICI veteran banker V.N. Srivatsan as Chief Compliance Officer
articles.summary: HDFC Bank names ICICI veteran banker V.N. Srivatsan as Chief Compliance Officer HDFC Bank has appointed V.N. Srivatsan as its Chief Compliance Officer for a three-year term, effective from his joining date on January 4, 2027. Srivatsan, currently Head – Compliance: Overseas Banking and Subsidiaries & Data Privacy Officer at ICICI Bank, has around 34 years of professional experience, including 25 years in BFSI.

articles.headline: EaseMyTrip joins Apple Pay India launch to offer faster, seamless booking payments
articles.summary: EaseMyTrip joins Apple Pay India launch to offer faster, seamless booking payments EaseMyTrip has announced its partnership with Apple Pay to improve the payment process for its users. This collaboration aims to provide faster and more secure payment options during travel bookings. Customers can now complete their bookings without repeatedly entering payment details, enhancing convenience. Apple Pay officially launched in India recently, marking a significant development for online payments.

articles.headline: Festive shopping gets costlier as brands plan to hike AC, TV and appliance prices from October 1
articles.summary: Festive shopping gets costlier as brands plan to hike AC, TV and appliance prices from October 1 Consumer electronics and appliance manufacturers in India will increase prices of products by 5-8 per cent starting October 1. The rise in prices is attributed to higher costs of raw materials like copper and steel. Companies including Blue Star and Haier have confirmed these increases ahead of the festive shopping season. Despite the increases, some dealers have inventory stocked at old prices for the upcoming festivals.

articles.headline: FSSAI rules put beverage makers in a tizzy as ‘energy’ deadline looms
articles.summary: FSSAI rules put beverage makers in a tizzy as ‘energy’ deadline looms Red Bull has approached the Delhi High Court to dispute FSSAI's ban on energy drink labeling. The company argues that due process was not followed in the ban's implementation. Reliance has introduced Campa Xtra without the term 'energy' amid the new regulations. Industry executives express concerns about the impact on major energy drink brands in India. The energy drink market is significant, valued at approximately ₹9,500 crore in recent years.

articles.headline: To blunt pain, brands roll out pay plans
articles.summary: To blunt pain, brands roll out pay plans During this celebratory season, various brands are rolling out flexible payment solutions, such as staggered payment plans and no-cost EMIs, to help ease the burden of increasing product prices on shoppers. Retailers are prioritizing margin protection by introducing more affordable entry-level products rather than resorting to steep discounts, thereby enhancing the shopping experience through affordability and a touch of premium appeal.

articles.headline: India’s young consumers are giving Samsung’s AI appliance bet a big boost
articles.summary: India’s young consumers are giving Samsung’s AI appliance bet a big boost Samsung sees significant AI appliance growth in India, driven by younger consumers. Connected Samsung appliances in India saw a nearly nine-fold increase last year. The company plans to expand AI capabilities to mid-range and entry-level products. LG Electronics is also increasing its manufacturing footprint and strategic market focus. India is becoming a key testing ground for AI-enabled everyday consumer products.

articles.headline: Meta officials admit mistake, agree to report child abuse content directly to Indian Law Enforcement
articles.summary: Meta officials admit mistake, agree to report child abuse content directly to Indian Law Enforcement Meta officials admitted to a mistake during their appearance before the National Commission for Protection of Child Rights (NCPCR) on Wednesday and said the company would report child abuse content directly to Indian law enforcement agencies, government sources said.

articles.headline: Researchers used Claude to breach OpenAI's internal systems in under 72 hours
TRAI cracks the whip on spam calls; robocalls & pre-recorded messages to face action now
articles.summary: TRAI cracks the whip on spam calls; robocalls & pre-recorded messages to face action now New regulations aim to curb unsolicited commercial communications and spam calls. AI will now detect and flag suspected spam calls automatically. Entities using automated calls must pre-declare their usage to telecom providers. Consumers can appeal complaint resolutions and legacy consents will be digitized. Stricter actions will target repeat offenders and misuse of telecom resources.

articles.headline: YouTube Income: India's creator economy needs to be more serious after new monetisation criteria
articles.summary: YouTube Income: India's creator economy needs to be more serious after new monetisation criteria YouTube’s new Partner Programme eligibility norms are set to reshape India’s creator economy, raising the bar for monetisation and rewarding serious creators. The shift could boost original and long-form content, deepen audience engagement, professionalise creator careers and push brands towards niche influencers. With non-YPP income already dominating creator earnings, brand deals could become increasingly crucial.

articles.headline: What’s in a word? For India's FMCG brands, it's increasingly everything
articles.summary: What’s in a word? For India's FMCG brands, it's increasingly everything Indian regulators are intensifying scrutiny over misleading food product claims. Companies now face legal challenges for unsubstantiated marketing statements. New front-of-pack warning labels are proposed for unhealthy packaged foods. This regulatory push aims to provide consumers with clearer product information. Companies are consequently allocating more resources towards compliance and quality checks.

articles.headline: ICC eyes China in bid to expand cricket
articles.summary: ICC eyes China in bid to expand cricket China is emerging as a key target for growth as the International Cricket Council (ICC) seeks new fans worldwide, its chief executive says. "The continued success of their women's team has provided a major boost to cricket in the country," ICC chief executive Sanjog Gupta told AFP. China became a focus market after hosting cricket at the 2022 Asian Games in Hangzhou and through the progress of its women's national team, which has climbed 10 places in the world rankings over the past two years.

articles.headline: Regional movies post success without Hindi market focus
articles.summary: Regional movies post success without Hindi market focus Regional films now focus on home audiences, achieving success through strong content. These films are traveling across markets without Hindi dubbing, which is a significant shift. Streaming platforms have expanded audiences for regional cinema beyond their home territories. Culturally rooted stories are increasingly rewarded by audiences across all languages. This trend reflects a course correction in how regional films are conceived and distributed.

articles.headline: The winning: Brands and audiences are hungry for celebrities with distinct, dependable style
articles.summary: The winning: Brands and audiences are hungry for celebrities with distinct, dependable style In the social-media era, personal style has become a valuable business asset for celebrities and influencers. Authentic, recognisable fashion identities can generate massive media value, attract brand partnerships and help luxury labels enter India’s market. Celebrity airport looks now drive fashion sales through authentic presentation. Personal style has become a valuable currency in the fashion industry. Brands increasingly seek celebrities whose style aligns with their own identity. Influencers also play a role by contextualizing fashion for their audiences. This system, while promoting authenticity, also fuels constant consumption.

articles.headline: 69% of Gen Z card users borrow again within 12 months of first credit card: Report
As new phones, cars get costlier, Indians turn to second-hand market in droves
articles.summary: As new phones, cars get costlier, Indians turn to second-hand market in droves Consumers are increasingly turning to used phones and cars as new vehicle prices climb. Refurbished smartphones now make up over a quarter of sales, with the pre-owned car market also seeing significant growth. This trend is driven by higher component costs and price hikes on new models.

articles.headline: Australia teen social media ban has little impact: research
articles.summary: Australia teen social media ban has little impact: research Australia's social media ban for under 16s has had little impact on teenagers' scrolling habits, researchers said Thursday in one of the first evaluations of the world-leading measures. "Australia's world-leading social media laws are not failing.

articles.headline: India's D2C brands lose 94% of mobile shoppers without purchase: Report
articles.summary: Nearly 94 per cent of mobile shoppers visiting direct-to-consumer (D2C) brand websites in India leave without making a purchase, highlighting a major challenge for online retailers despite the country's rapidly growing mobile commerce market, according to a report by AppMaker, which recently joined StarApps.

articles.headline: Air India gets new boss as Tewolde Gebremariam takes charge
articles.summary: Air India gets new boss as Tewolde Gebremariam takes charge Tewolde Gebremariam officially assumes operational leadership at Air India this Monday, taking over from Campbell Wilson. With mounting pressure to elevate safety and reliability standards, Gebremariam aims to enhance engineering and maintenance functions while prioritizing financial discipline and profitability. He is expected to have significant autonomy to drive sustainable operational practices.

articles.headline: Kotak Mahindra Bank names Anup Kumar Saha as new MD and CEO
articles.summary: Kotak Mahindra Bank names Anup Kumar Saha as new MD and CEO Anup Kumar Saha has been appointed as the new Managing Director and CEO of Kotak Mahindra Bank. His tenure will start on January 1, 2027, and last for three years. Currently serving as an Executive Director, he has over 32 years of experience in financial services. He joined Kotak Mahindra Bank in January 2026 and previously handled multiple functions there.

articles.headline: Naomi Osaka’s $5M business milestone comes as the tennis star builds a powerful empire beyond her tennis career
articles.summary: Naomi Osaka’s $5M business milestone comes as the tennis star builds a powerful empire beyond her tennis career Naomi Osaka is building far beyond tennis. Her business portfolio includes Hana Kuma, KINLÒ, investments in women’s soccer and pickleball, and an earlier equity stake in BodyArmor. Now she is moving into luxury goods, where she has unveiled a handbag prototype with Mike Cherman. The new venture gives Osaka a chance to create and shape her own brand.

articles.headline: Smartphone companies step up festive hiring
articles.summary: Smartphone companies step up festive hiring Brands and manufacturers have also initiated recruitment significantly earlier this year, moving away from reactive, last-minute hiring towards a more structured pipeline initiated 12-14 weeks ahead of the festive peak, said Yeshab Giri, chief commercial officer, operational talent solutions, Randstad India. Randstad expects seasonal hiring to grow 12-15 per cent increase over last festive season, led by targeted deployment across retail counters, field sales, and consumer engagement roles.

articles.headline: Bajaj Life Insurance elevates Vivek Gupta as Chief Operations and CX Officer
articles.summary: Bajaj Life Insurance has officially welcomed Vivek Gupta as its new Chief Operations and Customer Experience Officer. In this pivotal position, Gupta is tasked with overseeing operations, enhancing customer experiences, and driving the company's innovation strategy. With over 20 years in the insurance sector specializing in business transformation, he is poised to elevate customer trust and streamline service offerings under Tarun Chugh's confident leadership.

articles.headline: Vadilal Industries strikes fresh deal with Vadilal Enterprises amid family dispute
articles.summary: Vadilal Industries strikes fresh deal with Vadilal Enterprises amid family dispute Vadilal Industries Ltd has signed a revised supply agreement with Vadilal Enterprises for a 12-month period. This agreement is set to be effective from November 1, 2026, to October 31, 2027. The previous 10-year agreement was due to end on September 30, 2026, and could not be renewed. A family dispute within the promoter Gandhi family has complicated operational issues and leadership restructuring.

articles.headline: Buoyant Q2 demand for consumer goods lifts festive sales outlook
articles.summary: Buoyant Q2 demand for consumer goods lifts festive sales outlook Consumer demand in India saw significant growth during the July-September quarter, particularly in appliances and FMCGs. Sales of air conditioners, refrigerators, and branded apparel experienced double-digit growth closely following the festive season. Price increases partially influenced this growth amidst a low base from last year. Despite higher commodity costs and a weaker rupee, consumer sentiment appears to be positive.

articles.headline: DigiPlus Fest 2026: From clicks to conversations, marketers turn to intent as the new signal
articles.summary: As the landscape of commerce evolves, conversations play a pivotal role in deciphering consumer intentions during their purchasing journey and beyond. Marketing leaders advocate for early detection of buying signals. By employing chatbots and AI-driven tools, brands can collect essential data prior to direct consumer engagement. This new strategic framework encourages meaningful relationships that persist after the sale, focusing on the holistic understanding of customer needs.

articles.headline: Reckitt appoints Guntas Randhawa as Health marketing director for South Asia
articles.summary: Reckitt has appointed Guntas Randhawa as its Regional Marketing Director for Health South Asia. Randhawa will manage marketing strategies for key consumer health brands, including Dettol and Durex. She has joined Reckitt after a 17-year career at Hindustan Unilever, where she held significant leadership roles. In her new position, she aims to innovate while ensuring the brand portfolio is relevant for younger consumers.

articles.headline: Campaigns don't build brands. People do.
articles.summary: Cathy Fu was responsible for developing effective bank brochures for Chinese-American customers of Washington Mutual. Her work focused on addressing the specific banking challenges faced by the community. This resulted in increased customer deposits and satisfaction at the bank. The success of her efforts highlighted the importance of understanding client needs beyond traditional advertising methods. Ultimately, brand perception is shaped by the cumulative experiences of every interaction in an organization.

articles.headline: DigiPlus Fest 2026: How Kotak Mahindra Bank is scaling hyper-personalisation from consumer insights to experiences
articles.summary: DigiPlus Fest 2026: How Kotak Mahindra Bank is scaling hyper-personalisation from consumer insights to experiences In a bid to transform customer experiences, Kotak Mahindra Bank is rolling out an integrated approach leveraging advanced data insights. By synthesizing behavioral analysis, predictive modeling, and consumer feedback, the bank gains a deeper understanding of its clientele. Utilizing AI-generated personalized communication, targeted marketing strategies are deployed to suit various consumer profiles, while proactive engagement is emphasized, ensuring cross-selling is both timely and relevant for all customers involved.

articles.headline: Dheeraj Sinha re-elected president of The Advertising Club for 2026–27
articles.summary: Dheeraj Sinha re-elected president of The Advertising Club for 2026–27 Dheeraj Sinha has been re-elected as president of The Advertising Club for the 2026-27 fiscal year. The announcement occurred during the 72nd annual general meeting held in Mumbai. Alongside Sinha, other office bearers have been appointed, aiming to enhance the club's efforts. The committee plans to maintain continuity while embracing change in the industry. The focus will be on amplifying diverse perspectives that will shape the industry's future.

articles.headline: Sandeep Goyal elected president of AAAI for 2026–27
articles.summary: Sandeep Goyal elected president of AAAI for 2026–27 Sandeep Goyal has been elected as the president of the Advertising Agencies Association of India for 2026-27. Jaydeep R Gandhi has been appointed as the vice-president during the same term. The newly formed board includes several prominent figures in the advertising industry. Sandeep Goyal expressed his commitment to innovation and supporting the advertising and media ecosystem. The names of additional board members will be announced after the next board meeting.

articles.headline: Sanjay Kumar Chaudhary elevated to head of marketing at SAP Concur India
articles.summary: Sanjay Kumar Chaudhary has been elevated as the senior marketing director and head of marketing at SAP Concur India. With over 25 years in B2B marketing, focusing on strategic marketing across various sectors.

articles.headline: Now, licences of iconic Irani eatery Kyani & 12 others suspended
articles.summary: Now, licences of iconic Irani eatery Kyani & 12 others suspended Following rigorous inspections, the FDA has suspended the food licenses of several restaurants due to alarming hygiene violations. Kyani & Co. faced immediate closure over severe sanitation issues like rodent droppings and dead insects. Colaba Sweet Mart and a Subway outlet in Lower Parel also encountered suspensions for similar problems.

articles.headline: India’s media industry needs to move from scale to value: Prabhat
articles.summary: Prabhat emphasized the need for India's media and entertainment industry to create enduring economic value. He noted that overwhelming scale of content production is insufficient for sustainability and growth in creative enterprises. Greater investment in original intellectual property and improved protection against piracy were highlighted as essential.

articles.headline: Singapore has a new rule that could cost tourists $5,500. Here's what you need to know
articles.summary: Singapore has a new rule that could cost tourists $5,500. Here's what you need to know Singapore has implemented tougher penalties to curb disruptive behaviors on its public transport system, aiming to enhance the experience for all commuters. Serious offenses, which may include loud music and inappropriate seat usage, could incur fines up to 5,000 Singapore dollars. Authorities stress the importance of mutual respect among passengers and remind visitors to familiarize themselves with these regulations to steer clear of penalties.

articles.headline: Mercedes-backed Momenta targets Dubai and Europe for robotaxi expansion
articles.summary: Mercedes-backed Momenta targets Dubai and Europe for robotaxi expansion Chinese autonomous-driving company Momenta Global aims to have thousands of robotaxis on the road next year as it looks to expand to Dubai and more cities in Europe, the head of its robotaxi business told Reuters.

articles.headline: Media has bigger role to play in building Brand India: Uday Shankar
articles.summary: Media has bigger role to play in building Brand India: Uday Shankar Uday Shankar, at FICCI Frames, discussed the media industry's responsibility in building Brand India. He highlighted the need for diverse storytelling in news, entertainment, and sports. Shankar emphasized that media shapes society's imagination and aspirations for a better future. He acknowledged the industry's changes with a younger generation bringing innovative ideas and solutions. Overall, he believes the media's role is critical in shaping India's narrative and identity.

articles.headline: Human touch in AI era & 'original' Indian piece in reels & movie puzzle
articles.summary: Human touch in AI era & 'original' Indian piece in reels & movie puzzle Tourism and Culture Minister Gajendra Singh Shekhawat sees a human comeback in an AI-heavy content world, predicting audiences will gravitate towards more authentic, less AI-driven storytelling. He also wants India to move from being a massive content consumer to a global creator of original IP, using its stories to power tourism and creative economy.

articles.headline: US says GM tech costs to drop by USD 20 bln through 2031 due to new emissions rules
articles.summary: US says GM tech costs to drop by USD 20 bln through 2031 due to new emissions rules Looser US fuel economy rules are set to reduce automakers’ technology costs by USD 60.6 billion through 2031, with GM alone seeing a USD 20.4 billion decline.

articles.headline: Hinge targets singles with "Made for Love" campaign
articles.summary: Hinge targets singles with "Made for Love" campaign With the introduction of its 'Made for Love' initiative, Hinge seeks to transform the dating landscape in India. The brand film illustrates the rising need for sincerity and trust in connections among singles, reflecting Hinge's commitment to fostering genuine relationships over fleeting interactions. This initiative is crafted especially for young urban women who cherish their privacy.

articles.headline: Disney laying off several hundred employees, Variety reports
articles.summary: Disney laying off several hundred employees, Variety reports Walt Disney is implementing layoffs affecting a few hundred positions in human resources and IT departments. The company witnessed significant changes in its executive leadership, including the appointment of Paul Roeder. Disney previously cut approximately 1,000 roles across multiple divisions during April of this year. Last year, the company also laid off several hundred employees in various departments, including marketing and casting.

articles.headline: Bigger picture: Media industry shifts focus to attention, data & tech
articles.summary: Bigger picture: Media industry shifts focus to attention, data & tech Senior executives from the media and entertainment industry discussed the shift towards an attention economy. They noted technology, data, and audience insights as key growth drivers. Companies are focusing on creating intellectual properties rather than solely acquiring rights. There is an emphasis on personalizing content to engage viewers more effectively. Executives highlighted regional content and connected TVs as emerging trends for increasing audience engagement.

articles.headline: Toyota car plants, Thai Airways cargo hit by Thailand floods
articles.summary: Toyota car plants, Thai Airways cargo hit by Thailand floods Severe flooding in Thailand has caused the temporary shutdown of four Toyota plants and disrupted operations at Thai Airways. Heavy rainfall in Bangkok led to significant flooding affecting many residents and businesses. The government is working to drain floodwaters and restore normalcy as soon as possible. The death toll from the flooding has reached at least 40, with many provinces impacted.

articles.headline: Lufthansa CEO says jet fuel hit to top EUR 1.5 billion forecast
articles.summary: Lufthansa CEO says jet fuel hit to top EUR 1.5 billion forecast Lufthansa's CEO, Carsten Spohr, indicated that the airline's fuel costs will exceed the previously estimated EUR 1.5 billion. The increased costs are attributed to the ongoing Iran war and rising oil prices impacting the airline industry. Despite this, Lufthansa is maintaining an operating profit forecast between EUR 1.7 billion and EUR 2.2 billion for the current fiscal year.

articles.headline: Whistleblower loses fee bid in Walgreens' USD 4.7 billion settlement with US states
articles.summary: Whistleblower loses fee bid in Walgreens' USD 4.7 billion settlement with US states A federal judge ruled against pharmacist T.J. Novak's claim for a portion of Walgreens' settlement funds. Novak alleged that Walgreens filled illegal opioid prescriptions and sought reimbursement from government programs. The settlement of USD 4.7 billion with states did not include provisions for Novak's claims. The judge stated that individual state courts must address the legal questions involved in this case.

Happy Returns will assist in processing returns at various retail locations like Ulta Beauty and Staples. The collaboration seeks to improve inventory turnaround and minimize return fraud through AI tools.

articles.headline: WPP Media study highlights the growing role of non-metro markets in product launches

articles.headline: Under-the-counter cash gold sales boom in India as high prices and taxes bite
articles.summary: Under-the-counter cash gold sales boom in India as high prices and taxes bite High gold prices, combined with higher taxes, are encouraging more buyers to engage in cash transactions. This trend allows buyers to save significantly compared to official market prices based on reported cases. As import levies have doubled, the informal gold market is thriving, especially in the lead-up to wedding season. Retail customers are discovering varying discounts, influencing their purchasing decisions significantly.

articles.headline: 'The emperor is naked': UEFA's Ceferin takes aim at FIFA boss Infantino
articles.summary: 'The emperor is naked': UEFA's Ceferin takes aim at FIFA boss Infantino UEFA President Aleksander Ceferin said 'the emperor is naked' on Tuesday in a blistering attack on FIFA President Gianni Infantino and his failed plan to sell a stake in the governing body's commercial rights to private investors.

articles.headline: White goods sellers offer discounts, clearance sale to woo festive buyers
articles.summary: White goods sellers offer discounts, clearance sale to woo festive buyers Retailers in Kolkata are implementing strategies to counteract the recent price hikes in electronic goods during the festive season. They are offering clearance sales on old stock, alongside new stock with festive discounts and EMI schemes to encourage purchases. Retailers aim to keep consumer engagement high despite inflation concerns.

articles.headline: The rise and fall of forgotten coffee brands that shaped American nostalgia and culture
articles.summary: The rise and fall of forgotten coffee brands that shaped American nostalgia and culture Many Americans recall coffee brands like Gold Shield and Savarin that were once common in homes. These brands can evoke strong feelings due to their connection to memories and family rituals. The shift to larger chains and specialty coffee has diminished the presence of these once-familiar names. While some major brands like Folgers continue, many smaller brands have vanished from stores.

articles.headline: Delhi HC sets aside FSSAI order directing Red Bull India to drop ‘energy’ from drinks
articles.summary: Delhi HC sets aside FSSAI order directing Red Bull India to drop ‘energy’ from drinks Delhi High Court has overturned the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India's recent order against Red Bull India. Red Bull's use of the term 'Energy Drink' was challenged without a proper hearing or notice.

articles.headline: Only 1 in 4 festive season hires move into permanent roles: Experts
articles.summary: Frontline hiring is increasing across various sectors due to India's festive season and rising order volumes. Tempting demand for temporary roles is expected to grow significantly this year, especially in logistics and retail. However, only a small percentage of seasonal hires are likely to transition to permanent positions after the festive period ends. Employers are increasingly combining permanent staff with flexible talent to optimally meet business demands.

articles.summary: General Motors to build 75% fewer Chevrolet Bolt EVs amid subsidy rollback The Kansas City-area plant expects to produce only 35,000 Bolts instead of 150,000 by early next year. This number is far below the earlier 150,000 target as EV demand weakens following the withdrawal of US federal incentives. General Motors is cutting Chevrolet Bolt production by about 75 percent as federal support has diminished. articles.summary: Have Q-commerce uniforms impacted everyday fashion trends? Quick commerce has claimed the boldest colours on India’s streets. Has this ruined them for everyday fashion? Delivery brands like Zomato and Swiggy have popularised specific colors in urban apparel markets. Despite these colors' association with work uniforms, consumers continue to purchase clothing in similar shades. The vibrant Indian apparel market is less inhibited by color perceptions compared to Western preferences. Cultural significance plays a vital role in the acceptance of colors like red and orange.

articles.headline: “Mass Market Should Not Be Defined by a Price Point,” Maruti Suzuki's Partho Banerjee
articles.summary: Maruti Suzuki is experiencing a shift in consumer expectations, driven by increasing aspirations and evolving preferences. articles.summary: ChatGPT Ads: For Your Kind Attention, Please OpenAI recently introduced ChatGPT Ads in India to explore new advertising formats within conversational AI. articles.headline: As consumers go big on experiences, private equity follows
articles.summary: As consumers go big on experiences, private equity follows Current trends indicate that young consumers in India are prioritizing experiences over material goods as their spending increases. Investors are seeking opportunities to capitalize on changing consumer preferences and social media influences.

articles.summary: India’s streaming gold rush shifts to creators as Samay Raina, Bhuvan Bam step into OTTs India's streaming platforms are evolving by embracing individual creators as significant content intellectual properties. Platforms like Netflix and Amazon Prime Video are showcasing works from these creators to attract viewers. This approach signals a shift towards more fluid boundaries between digital and mainstream entertainment.

articles.headline: Rising jet fuel demand to boost India’s sustainable aviation fuel market
articles.summary: Rising jet fuel demand to boost India’s sustainable aviation fuel market India's jet fuel demand will rise from 192,000 barrels per day in 2024 to 277,000 barrels per day by 2031. The government plans to introduce a SAF blending roadmap starting in 2027 with gradual increases. This advancement supports decarbonization and responds to growth in air travel and infrastructure development. New airports are expected to ease capacity constraints and enhance connectivity further.

articles.headline: Reliance Jio leads mobile subscriber additions, adds 24 lakh users in August: TRAI data
articles.summary: Reliance Jio added 24 lakh mobile subscribers in August, leading the market according to TRAI data. articles.headline: Anthropic warns IPO investors AI could pose 'catastrophic' risks to humanity: Report

articles.headline: Boeing shares tumble on new MAX software glitch
articles.summary: Boeing shares tumble on new MAX software glitch Shares of American plane manufacturer Boeing fell about five percent Monday following a new software problem with the 737 MAX that can affect an automated navigation system. articles.headline: Japan’s content giants seek bigger India play through films and IP
articles.summary: Japan’s content giants seek bigger India play through films and IP Japan's content industry seeks to increase its presence in India through licensing, merchandising, and localization of animation properties. Research shows a high penetration of anime viewership among Indian audiences, indicating potential for commercial growth.

articles.headline: Air India CEO-designate Tewolde Gebremariam flags safety, reliability, profitability as key priorities
articles.summary: Air India CEO-designate Tewolde Gebremariam flags safety, reliability, profitability as key priorities Air India's CEO Tewolde Gebremariam has outlined priorities focused on safety, operational reliability, and sustainable profitability. The airline has seen significant progress after returning to the Tata Group and integrating with Vistara. Challenges from geopolitical developments and rising operational costs continue to persist in the aviation sector. Tewolde emphasized the need for improved on-time performance and customer service to rebuild trust.

articles.headline: FSSAI crackdown sparks hiring surge in food safety and compliance
articles.summary: FSSAI crackdown sparks hiring surge in food safety and compliance Large food companies and restaurants are expanding their hiring for food safety and compliance roles. Restaurant chains are also implementing internal audits and training programs to enhance food safety practices.

articles.headline: In healthcare, the patient is the least informed consumer
articles.summary: In healthcare, the patient is the least informed consumer Significant price differences in healthcare consumables have drawn attention, prompting calls for better consumer protection. Maharashtra's FDA has uncovered alarming disparities, highlighting information asymmetry faced by patients. The Supreme Court reaffirmed consumer accountability for medical services, emphasizing the need for transparency. Consumers are encouraged to ask questions and take advantage of available grievance mechanisms. Strengthening enforcement and data-sharing among regulators can improve the integrity of healthcare transactions.

articles.headline: Aman Gupta backs former Boat colleague's home decor startup
articles.summary: Aman Gupta backs former Boat colleague's home decor startup In a significant move, Aman Gupta has invested in Fig Living, a creatively designed home decor brand established by Sushant Sharma after their journey at Boat. articles.headline: China's consumer sector stocks nosedive, reflecting lopsided economy
articles.summary: China's consumer sector stocks nosedive, reflecting lopsided economy In some more bad news for the Chinese economy, MSCI China's consumer goods sub-indices plunged roughly 18 per cent over the past six months, nearing 10-year low.

articles.headline: Audiences that upgrade to CTV upgrade their viewing habits
articles.summary: Audiences that upgrade to CTV upgrade their viewing habits As more households embrace Connected TV, their viewing habits are changing too. articles.headline: ASCI introduces guidelines for labelling AI-generated content in advertising
articles.summary: ASCI introduces guidelines for labelling AI-generated content in advertising The Advertising Standards Council of India (ASCI) has issued official guidelines for labelling AI-generated content in advertising. articles.headline: DigiPlus Fest 2026: Media plans without CTV risk missing a third of affluent viewers
articles.summary: DigiPlus Fest 2026: Media plans without CTV risk missing a third of affluent viewers Marketers and media leaders discussed the growing relevance of Connected TV in advertising during DigiPlus Fest 2026. Measurement challenges remain significant, particularly concerning cross-device interactions and incremental reach.

articles.headline: Harsh Mariwala says one Marico product failure taught company a key lesson about Indian consumers, shares Saffola Oats success formula
articles.summary: Marico's initial attempt to launch a new snack under the Saffola brand faltered due to a lack of appealing taste. articles.headline: JioStar seeks immediate restoration of BARC ratings, regulatory roadmap for linear TV
articles.summary: JioStar seeks immediate restoration of BARC ratings, regulatory roadmap for linear TV JioStar CEO Kevin Vaz emphasized the urgent need for the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting to restore BARC audience ratings. articles.headline: Apple and Amazon face revived UK consumer lawsuit over product sales
articles.summary: Apple and Amazon face revived UK consumer lawsuit over product sales Britain's Competition Appeal Tribunal on Monday allowed part of a consumer lawsuit against Apple and Amazon to proceed over claims they restricted competition in the sale of Apple products on Amazon's UK marketplace.

articles.headline: DigiPlus Fest 2026: Streaming accounts for 95% of viewing time on Samsung smart TVs in India
articles.summary: DigiPlus Fest 2026: Streaming accounts for 95% of viewing time on Samsung smart TVs in India Connected TV (CTV) is reshaping modern media habits, and smart TV original equipment manufacturers (OEMs) are turning living-room screens into intelligent engines for high-impact brand storytelling, AI-driven contextual targeting, and performance-led commerce. articles.headline: Sunder Balasubramanian exits Myntra
articles.summary: Sunder Balasubramanian, the Chief Marketing Officer of Myntra, has announced his departure after four years with the organisation. articles.summary: From mass reach to precision reach: Is CTV creating a new role for television advertising? articles.headline: Nirma professor who grabbed student by collar sparks fresh row over ‘HK the brand’ video

articles.summary: OpenAI partners with Sachin Tendulkar to drive AI adoption in India OpenAI has announced a partnership with Sachin Tendulkar to promote ChatGPT across India. The initial launch will feature content showing Tendulkar engaging with ChatGPT through questions and discussions. Future videos will include Tendulkar and entrepreneur Varun Mayya exploring more uses of the tool.

articles.headline: HSBC mutual fund launches #StayDiSIPlined campaign to encourage systematic investing
articles.summary: HSBC mutual fund launches #StayDiSIPlined campaign to encourage systematic investing HSBC mutual fund has rolled out the '#StayDiSIPlined' initiative specifically for retail investors aged 25 to 45. This innovative campaign seeks to instill consistency in Systematic Investment Plans (SIPs) by managing emotional responses to market ups and downs. Drawing similarities to fitness disciplines, it stresses the impact of emotions on long-term financial strategies.

articles.headline: Skinn ropes in Ayushmann Khurrana and Sobhita Dhulipala as brand ambassadors
articles.summary: Skinn ropes in Ayushmann Khurrana and Sobhita Dhulipala as brand ambassadors Actors Ayushmann Khurrana and Sobhita Dhulipala have been named as brand ambassadors for Skinn. The brand has launched a campaign titled 'Make every moment special' to promote fine fragrances. This campaign encourages consumers to incorporate fragrance into their daily routines instead of using them just for special occasions. Commenting on the campaign, Skinn executives addressed the evolving perception of fragrance among consumers.

articles.headline: India’s consumer durables market may reach INR 3.25 lakh crore by 2030: BCG-CII report
articles.summary: India Consumer Durables Market: A recent report by BCG and CII predicts India’s consumer durables market will grow at 8-10% annually, reaching INR 3.25 lakh crore by 2030. articles.headline: Rado steps up premium play in India as Swiss watch market grows 31 per cent
articles.summary: Rado Watches In India: Rado, the Swiss watchmaker, marks India as its largest global market with a remarkable 31% growth in Swiss watch imports. Discover Rado's strategies to cater to younger consumers and expanding demand for premium timepieces.

articles.headline: PVR made a customer sit through 17 mins of extra advertisements before his movie began, ordered to pay INR 75,000
articles.summary: PVR made a customer sit through 17 mins of extra advertisements before his movie began, ordered to pay INR 75,000 A Hyderabad advocate who booked a late night movie ticket ended up filing a consumer case after PVR Cinemas ran advertisements well past the scheduled start time, delaying the film and pushing his return home by nearly an hour. The Hyderabad District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission has now ordered PVR INOX to pay him INR 75,000 in total.

articles.headline: Costly Diwali: Appliance makers set to serve up another price shock
articles.summary: Diwali Price Increase: Leading appliance manufacturers raise prices by up to 10% ahead of Diwali due to rising input costs, impacting consumer electronics and sales growth. Learn more about the price hikes and what it means for the festive season.

articles.headline: Eye on India cocktail, Suntory eyes 10-15 per cent stake in Allied Blenders & Distillers
articles.summary: Suntory Holdings is in early discussions to acquire a 10-15% stake in Allied Blenders & Distillers, aiming to strengthen its presence in India's lucrative whisky market. The deal reflects Suntory's strategy to combine its premium offerings with Allied's mass market reach.

articles.headline: Mass market automakers gaining ground in the premium segment; Mercedes, BMW work out different strategies to drive growth
articles.summary: Luxury Car Brands: India's luxury car market is evolving as mass market automakers like Toyota and Kia gain traction. Discover how Mercedes-Benz and BMW are adapting their strategies to maintain relevance in a changing landscape.

articles.headline: Tata Motors PV eyes 15 per cent market share soon, targets 20 per cent by FY31, says MD Shailesh Chandra
articles.summary: Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles is on the verge of achieving a 15% domestic market share and aims to reach 20% by FY31, driven by strategic investments and a focus on electric and sustainable powertrains, as stated by MD Shailesh Chandra.

articles.headline: Meta refused to run ads promoting Elon Musk's documentary; calls it 'error and ...'
articles.summary: Meta refused to run ads promoting Elon Musk's documentary; calls it 'error and ...' Meta initially rejected ads for Elon Musk’s documentary due to its classification as political content. After backlash, Meta corrected the error and will now run the promotional advertisements. YouTube also faced issues with the documentary's paid advertising but has since cleared it to run. The documentary, directed by Alex Gibney, delves into Musk's life and career and premieres on October 9.

articles.headline: How brands leveraged World Tourism Day this year

articles.headline: Can ice-cream brands stay premium as competition heats up?
articles.summary: Can ice-cream brands stay premium as competition heats up? Bombay Creamery, launched by Reliance Consumer Products, is redefining premiumisation within India's expanding ice cream market. As ice cream consumption shifts towards impulse purchases and unique flavors, consumers expect more value. Quick commerce is altering how ice cream is marketed and purchased, making accessibility crucial for brands. Established companies must enhance product visibility and unique experiences to justify their prices. Exclusive

articles.headline: The great Indian re-gift economy
articles.summary: The great Indian re-gift economy Why your diwali gift needs to be designed to be given away. Again. And again. And again.
