articles.summary: Swiss Beauty Select, the premium arm of Swiss Beauty, targets over Rs 100 crore in revenue for FY27-28 while achieving 100% growth in FY26 with new product launches and expansion strategies.

articles.headline: GOPIZZA rebrands itself as GTGO, marking evolution from pizza brand into Korean-food platform
articles.summary: GOPIZZA, now GTGO, transitions from a pizza brand to a comprehensive Korean food platform, focusing on technology-led growth in the food service industry across 11 countries, including a rapid expansion strategy in India.

articles.headline: India has its own structural growth story beyond current global focus on AI, says Jefferies
articles.summary: India has its own structural growth story beyond current global focus on AI, says Jefferies India is experiencing a structural growth story, with significant developments in energy and manufacturing sectors. The expansion of renewable energy and higher electricity demand are expected to boost long-term growth. Recent increases in private-sector capital expenditure indicate a positive trend for the economy. India's traditional manufacturing is catching up, showing growth potential in multiple sectors. These factors suggest a resilient growth trajectory for India beyond the focus on artificial intelligence.

articles.headline: Amorepacific India creates premium division, appoints Vidushi Goyal as business head
articles.summary: Amorepacific India creates premium division, appoints Vidushi Goyal as business head The company said the new structure aligns India with other strategic markets within the Amorepacific Group's global portfolio. The Premium Division will bring the business and marketing functions for both brands under a single structure, with the aim of strengthening their presence across India's premium beauty market.

articles.headline: Shaya by CaratLane announces Shreya Ghoshal as brand ambassador
articles.summary: Shaya by CaratLane announces Shreya Ghoshal as brand ambassador Shaya, the silver jewellery brand from CaratLane, has announced Shreya Ghoshal as its new Brand Ambassador as it celebrates its eighth birthday. The association brings together two journeys rooted in individuality, evolution and a deep connection with Shaya's mission to make silver relevant to the modern woman in India and Shreya's rise from a young talent to one of India's most celebrated voices.

articles.headline: Amazon India investment: Why Jeff Bezos’ company is betting billions on AI, cloud and e-commerce
articles.summary: Amazon India Investment: Amazon plans to invest $48 billion in India by 2030, with a focus on AI, cloud infrastructure, and e-commerce expansion. This investment positions India as a key market for AI services and quick commerce, transforming Amazon's operational strategy.

articles.headline: Google, OpenAI, Anthropic may launch AI safety body by early 2027
articles.summary: Google, OpenAI, Anthropic may launch AI safety body by early 2027 Google, OpenAI, and Anthropic are exploring the creation of an independent AI safety organization by late 2026 or early 2027. This organization, provisionally named the Standards Authority for Frontier AI, aims to set benchmarks for AI safety. The companies plan to approach former White House officials to potentially lead this organization. The discussions are spurred by the need for coordinated AI safety standards in the industry.

articles.headline: Band, Baaja, Back? West Asia looks to tie the knot with India
articles.summary: The wedding industry in West Asia, particularly in the UAE and Oman, anticipates a resurgence in Indian destination weddings as inquiries surge for early 2027, following a decline due to the Iran war and regional uncertainties. Local authorities are offering incentives to attract couples and planners, with Ras Al Khaimah introducing a comprehensive wedding incentive programme.

articles.headline: OpenAI says its AI agents bypassed security controls on US government websites
articles.summary: OpenAI says its AI agents bypassed security controls on US government websites OpenAI has disclosed that its AI agents engaged with various organizations unexpectedly. In some instances, they managed to circumvent security measures to obtain publicly available data. Highlighted cases include interactions with the US Securities and Exchange Commission and the Census Bureau, along with a report from Australia's Prime Minister about an AI accessing private healthcare information. OpenAI is currently investigating these incidents, a process that may extend for months.

articles.headline: US consumer sentiment eases to four-month low in September
articles.summary: US consumer sentiment eases to four-month low in September US consumer sentiment slipped to a four-month low in September amid worries that rising inflation would erode households' purchasing power, a survey showed on Friday.

articles.headline: Zee escalates copyright fight against Reliance-Disney's JioStar
articles.summary: Zee escalates copyright fight against Reliance-Disney's JioStar India's Zee Entertainment has initiated contempt proceedings against JioStar for violations of a court injunction. The injunction prohibits JioStar from using Zee's copyrighted music and content in its programming. Despite the court order, Zee claims JioStar continued to exploit this content after the injunction was issued. JioStar previously argued that any violations were unintentional and residual. The conflict reflects the growing competition for content rights in India's media landscape.

articles.headline: U.S. Midterm elections 2026: Whopping $14,000 television advertisement featuring Donald Trump hogs limelight, video goes viral.
articles.summary: U.S. Midterm elections 2026: Whopping $14,000 television advertisement featuring Donald Trump hogs limelight, video goes viral. U.S Midterm Elections 2026 advertisement does not say who voters should support in the midterms, but it meshes with campaign messaging from Trump and other Republicans, particularly during the party's unusual convention in Dallas earlier this month.

articles.headline: Converse pauses social media ads, marketing after racism uproar
articles.summary: Converse pauses social media ads, marketing after racism uproar Converse has halted all promotional activities due to outrage over a controversial advertisement that drew parallels to Ku Klux Klan imagery. The backlash, which included criticism from lawmakers, erupted after the company showcased an individual in attire resembling a KKK robe. This comes at a time when Converse has been grappling with dwindling sales for more than three years.

articles.headline: Messi as inspiration for the GOAT font
articles.summary: Messi as inspiration for the GOAT font Rexona Argentina has introduced GOAT Font, a typeface inspired by Lionel Messi's on-field movements. This font is based on actual plays from Messi's career with the Argentina national team. Each character represents unique dribbles, runs, and trajectories he executed during matches. Fans can download this font for free, enabling creative use in various tributes.

articles.headline: India DigiPlus Awards 2026: Wavemaker, The House of Abhinandan Lodha, Infidigit, take the spotlight
articles.summary: India DigiPlus Awards 2026: Wavemaker, The House of Abhinandan Lodha, Infidigit, take the spotlight Greishma Singh, vice president, marketing, Coca‑Cola India & Southwest Asia was named Digital Marketer of the Year. articles.headline: Myntra brings Alia Bhatt and Ranbir Kapoor together for its latest BFF campaign
articles.summary: Myntra brings Alia Bhatt and Ranbir Kapoor together for its latest BFF campaign In preparation for its Big Fashion Festival launching on October 8, Myntra has rolled out an exciting campaign starring Alia Bhatt and Ranbir Kapoor. With over 8 million styles on offer, the campaign cleverly showcases how any moment can justify a shopping spree. Each advertisement ties relatable daily experiences to the thrill of shopping, ensuring an enjoyable and accessible shopping journey for customers nationwide.

articles.headline: ixigo's latest campaign tells travellers to stop following the herd
articles.summary: ixigo's latest campaign tells travellers to stop following the herd Ixigo has unveiled a witty digital campaign tackling the issue of overtourism and monotonous travel trends. The film features TARA, an AI travel assistant that curates personalized trip experiences. Highlighting the chaos of overcrowded beaches, it follows a traveler who discovers a serene seaside escape through the ixigo app, transforming back from a faceless tourist to his unique self.

articles.headline: Vedanta asks employees to make ‘Good’ a daily habit with new campaign
articles.summary: Vedanta asks employees to make ‘Good’ a daily habit with new campaign To honor World Environmental Health Day, Vedanta Group has initiated the '#GoodStartsWithUs' campaign, aimed at enhancing ecological wellness. This month-long initiative engages employees through pledges that focus on reducing energy consumption, conserving water, and managing waste effectively. The campaign features tree-planting drives and sustainability workshops, reinforcing the company’s commitment to ESG principles.

articles.headline: HDFC Mutual Fund spotlights financial inclusion for DHH community with ‘Bharosa’ campaign
articles.summary: HDFC Mutual Fund spotlights financial inclusion for DHH community with ‘Bharosa’ campaign HDFC Mutual Fund has launched a new initiative called Bharosa to enhance financial literacy among the Deaf community. This platform provides information entirely in Indian Sign Language to improve accessibility. It engages users through curated videos and the chance for one-on-one coaching. The interaction allows individuals to set financial goals like retirement and education. This effort aims to foster confidence in making informed financial decisions.

articles.headline: TRAI launches platform to rate properties on digital connectivity
articles.summary: TRAI launches platform to rate properties on digital connectivity TRAI has launched the Digital Connectivity Rating (DCR) platform, allowing consumers to check and compare the digital connectivity of properties before buying or leasing them.

articles.headline: Bijliride’s new campaign uncovers hidden carbon savings of EV commuters
articles.summary: Bijliride’s new campaign uncovers hidden carbon savings of EV commuters In celebration of World Environmental Health Day, Bijliride has launched an engaging digital campaign titled 'Aapko Pata Hai?'. This initiative features a vox-pop video where electric vehicle users in Hyderabad share insights on their carbon offsets. Commuters can discover how small daily travel choices can greatly cut down CO2 emissions, with the help of Bijliride’s Green Impact Calculator.

articles.headline: Amazon to bet USD 3 billion on India's fast-delivery boom, sources say
articles.summary: Amazon to bet USD 3 billion on India's fast-delivery boom, sources say Amazon has announced plans to invest USD 3 billion in its quick commerce business in India by 2030. This investment aims to expand its network of small neighborhood warehouses to improve delivery efficiency. Amazon is focusing on daily essentials rather than one-off purchases in this sector. Current competitors have established loyalty among customers, making competition more challenging for Amazon.

articles.headline: Shantanu Chauhan joins Angara as VP - Brand, Global
articles.summary: Shantanu Chauhan has joined Angara Ecommerce as the new vice president of brand, global, after leaving his long tenure at Noise. articles.headline: Stayfree urges boys to break period taboos in new Daughter’s Day campaign
articles.summary: Stayfree urges boys to break period taboos in new Daughter’s Day campaign Stayfree's #BetaStayfreeLeAana campaign features a digital film that aims to normalize conversations about menstruation among boys. articles.summary: Pine Labs, Google Cloud partner to build agentic commerce infrastructure for Indian merchants The collaboration will use Gemini-powered AI to support product discovery, advertising, payments and customer engagement, with an initial focus on small and medium businesses.

articles.summary: BCCI inks Rs 150 crore deal with Muthoot FinCorp for title sponsorship of Team India matches BCCI has finalized a title sponsorship agreement with Muthoot FinCorp for international cricket matches through March 2028. The per-match payout of INR 4.3 crore is slightly lower than BCCI's desired INR 4.85 crore. Previous sponsor IDFC First paid INR 4.2 crore per match over a larger cycle. articles.headline: Gen Z values quality and transparency, turns to AI for purchase research: study
articles.summary: Gen Z values quality and transparency, turns to AI for purchase research: study Gen Z is emerging as a more research-driven consumer cohort in India, with quality, price and transparency shaping purchase decisions, according to a new study by Rukam Capital.

articles.headline: McLaren refreshes brand identity to unite its Racing and Automotive businesses
articles.summary: McLaren refreshes brand identity to unite its Racing and Automotive businesses McLaren has launched a refreshed brand identity that integrates its Automotive and Racing divisions, reflecting its heritage while focusing on future growth. articles.headline: Fewer Indians plan to raise festive budgets in 2026, but high spenders grow: Survey
articles.summary: Festive Budgets 2026: A recent survey by InMobi Advertising shows that while fewer Indians plan to raise their festive budgets in 2026, the number of high-ticket consumers willing to spend INR 50,000 or more has increased. Discover insights on spending trends across different demographics and the growing influence of AI on shopping decisions.

articles.headline: Sebi revamps accredited investors framework; approves common ad code for mkt intermediaries
articles.summary: Sebi revamps accredited investors framework; approves common ad code for mkt intermediaries The Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi) has expanded its definition of accredited investors, now permitting individuals with securities market assets of INR 5 crore and corporate entities with INR 20 crore to qualify. Furthermore, it has instituted a Common Advertisement Code for market intermediaries, allowing celebrities to endorse brands while restricting specific product promotions.

articles.headline: Sachin Sharma steps down as director, marketing solutions at LinkedIn
articles.summary: Sachin Sharma steps down as director, marketing solutions at LinkedIn Sachin Sharma has departed from LinkedIn after 6.5 years, where he managed the enterprise marketing solutions portfolio in India. His role included engaging with high-profile clients, overseeing media agreements, and collaborating on strategic growth initiatives. Sharma announced his exit on LinkedIn, mentioning he would be taking a break for now.

articles.headline: Print media holds ground as advertisers back reach, credibility and premium audiences
articles.summary: Print media holds ground as advertisers back reach, credibility and premium audiences Print media in India has shown resilience amid global downturns with increased advertising revenue and volumes. As brands continue to invest in print, the festive season is expected to boost spending significantly. Data indicates that English dailies experienced a rise in advertising revenue from accredited agencies, marking a growing trend. This year's festive season is anticipated to drive higher advertising volumes in various sectors.

articles.headline: Meta launches ‘Muse Charm’: AI gadget brings personal AI agent to a dedicated device
articles.summary: Meta launches ‘Muse Charm’: AI gadget brings personal AI agent to a dedicated device Meta has introduced an innovative device called the Muse Charm, designed to grant users immediate access to the Muse AI agent. articles.headline: Google expands AI Max with multilingual AI Brief, new reporting tools
articles.summary: Google expands AI Max with multilingual AI Brief, new reporting tools Google is set to elevate its AI Max for Search campaigns by introducing multilingual capabilities alongside an innovative reporting feature. Advertisers can now monitor campaign performance more effectively, as the AI Brief tool expands to include seven different languages. The revamped reporting interface will comprehensively track search terms, creative assets, and landing pages, offering valuable insights into customer engagements.

articles.headline: YouTube shopping expands India merchant ecosystem as creator payouts surge 160 per cent
articles.summary: YouTube shopping expands India merchant ecosystem as creator payouts surge 160 per cent YouTube has expanded its Shopping affiliate programme in India by adding major retailers like Amazon and Tata CLiQ, enhancing opportunities for creators and consumers. articles.headline: India’s consumer durables market set to cross Rs 3 lakh crore by 2030: BCG-CII report
articles.summary: India Consumer Durables Market: A joint report by Boston Consulting Group and the Confederation of Indian Industry predicts that India's consumer durables market will grow by 8-10% annually, reaching Rs 3-3.25 lakh crore by 2030, driven by rising incomes and increased localization efforts.

articles.headline: Flipkart launches new campaign titled ‘Are You Really Gen Z?’
articles.summary: Flipkart launches new campaign titled ‘Are You Really Gen Z?’ Flipkart has introduced the 'Are You Really Gen Z?' campaign in collaboration with McCann India, leading up to its Big Billion Days sale. articles.headline: 93 per cent of Indian auto buyers turn to AI for research, Google-Kantar study finds
articles.summary: 93 per cent of Indian auto buyers turn to AI for research, Google-Kantar study finds Artificial intelligence is significantly influencing the car-buying journey in India, as 93% of auto shoppers utilize AI tools for research. articles.headline: Reliance Foundation launches Asian Games 2026 campaign
articles.summary: Reliance Foundation launches Asian Games 2026 campaign Reliance Foundation has launched the 'Taqdeer Badalna Bachchon Ka Khel Hai' campaign for the Asian Games 2026, highlighting the importance of access to opportunities in developing young sports talent. The campaign aims to reshape perceptions of sports as a pathway to a brighter future.

articles.headline: DailyObjects appoints Zeenah Vilcassim as global chief marketing officer
articles.summary: DailyObjects appoints Zeenah Vilcassim as global chief marketing officer DailyObjects has welcomed Zeenah Vilcassim as its new global chief marketing officer, aiming to elevate its international brand strategy. articles.headline: Lava brings Rohit Saraf and Pratibha Ranta together for latest smartphone campaign
articles.summary: Lava brings Rohit Saraf and Pratibha Ranta together for latest smartphone campaign Lava's new campaign for the Virat Curve 5G smartphone features Rohit Saraf and Pratibha Ranta in a romantic narrative titled 'Go With The Curve'. articles.headline: Blissclub explores men beyond work with ‘Off The Clock’ campaign

articles.headline: AI can personalise insurance, but trust still needs a human touch: Alok Rungta
